name: Bulbasaur

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.text: Ups GRASS moves in a pinch.

dexText: There is a plant seed on its back right  from the day this POKéMON is born.  The seed slowly grows larger.

name: Ivysaur

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.text: Ups GRASS moves in a pinch.

dexText: There is a plant bulb on its back.  When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said  to blossom into a large flower.

name: Venusaur

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.text: Ups GRASS moves in a pinch.

dexText: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower.  The fragrance becalms those engaged in  a battle.

name: Charmander

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.text: Ups FIRE moves in a pinch.

dexText: From the time it is born, a flame burns  at the tip of its tail. Its life would end  if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.text: Ups FIRE moves in a pinch.

dexText: It lashes about with its tail to knock  down its foe. It then tears up the fallen  opponent with sharp claws.

name: Charizard

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.text: Ups FIRE moves in a pinch.

dexText: Its wings can carry this POKéMON close to  an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out  fire at very high temperatures.

name: Squirtle

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.text: Ups WATER moves in a pinch.

dexText: When it retracts its long neck into its  shell, it squirts out water with vigorous  force.

name: Wartortle

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.text: Ups WATER moves in a pinch.

dexText: This POKéMON is very popular as a pet.  Its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its  longevity.

name: Blastoise

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.text: Ups WATER moves in a pinch.

dexText: It crushes its foe under its heavy body  to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will  withdraw inside its shell.

name: Caterpie
dexText: It is covered with a green skin. When it  grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself  with silk, and becomes a cocoon.

name: Metapod
dexText: Even though it is encased in a sturdy  shell, the body inside is tender.  It can't withstand a harsh attack.

name: Butterfree
dexText: The wings are protected by rain-repellent  dust. As a result, this POKéMON can fly  about even in rain.

name: Weedle
dexText: Often found in forests and grasslands.  It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two  inches on top of its head.

name: Kakuna
dexText: This POKéMON is in a temporary stage  while making its body. It is almost  completely unable to move on its own.

name: Beedrill

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.text: Ups BUG moves in a pinch.

dexText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent  speeds, all the while stabbing with the  toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Pidgey
dexText: Does not like to fight. It hides in  tall grass and so on, foraging for food  such as small bugs.

name: Pidgeotto
dexText: The claws on its feet are well developed.  It can carry prey such as an EXEGGCUTE  to its nest over 60 miles away.

name: Pidgeot
dexText: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to  intimidate enemies. It races through the  skies at Mach-2 speed.

name: Rattata
dexText: Its fangs are long and very sharp.  They grow continuously, so it gnaws on  hard things to whittle them down.

name: Raticate
dexText: Its rear feet have three toes each.  They are webbed, enabling it to swim  across rivers.

name: Spearow
dexText: It busily flits around here and there.  Even if it is frail, it can be a tough  foe that uses MIRROR MOVE.

name: Fearow
dexText: Its huge and magnificent wings can keep it  aloft in the sky. It can remain flying a  whole day without landing.

name: Ekans
dexText: A very common sight in grassland, etc.  It flicks its tongue in and out to sense  danger in its surroundings.

name: Arbok
dexText: The pattern on its belly appears to be a  frightening face. Weak foes will flee just  at the sight of the pattern.

name: Pikachu
dexText: It has small electric sacs on both its  cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric  charges from the sacs.

name: Raichu
dexText: Its electric charges can reach even  100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause  even an Indian elephant to faint.

name: Sandshrew
dexText: It burrows and lives underground.  If threatened, it curls itself up into a  ball for protection.

name: Sandslash
dexText: It is adept at attacking with the spines  on its back and its sharp claws while  quickly scurrying about.

name: Nidoran♀
dexText: Though small, it must be treated with  caution because of its powerfully toxic  barbs. The female has smaller horns.

name: Nidorina
dexText: The female has a gentle temperament.  It emits ultrasonic cries that have the  power to befuddle foes.

name: Nidoqueen
dexText: The body is covered by stiff, needle-  like scales. If it becomes excited,  the needles bristle outwards.

name: Nidoran♂
dexText: Its large ears are flapped like wings  when it is listening to distant sounds.  It extends toxic barbs when angered.

name: Nidorino
dexText: It is easily angered. By swinging its well-  developed horn wildly, it can even punch  through diamond.

name: Nidoking
dexText: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide  and its extended horn. Be careful with  the horn as it contains venom.

name: Clefairy
dexText: Its adorable appearance makes it popular  as a pet. However, it is rare and  difficult to find.

name: Clefable
dexText: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can  easily hear a pin being dropped nearly  1,100 yards away.

name: Vulpix

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.text: Powers up if hit by fire.

dexText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails.  When it grows, several new tails are  sprouted.

name: Ninetales

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.text: Powers up if hit by fire.

dexText: It has nine long tails and fur that   gleams gold. It is said to live for   1,000 years.

name: Jigglypuff
dexText: It captivates foes with its huge, round  eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing  a soothing melody.

name: Wigglytuff
dexText: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and  supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur  conveys an image of luxury.

name: Zubat
dexText: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on  its ultrasonic cries for echo location to  flit about in darkness.

name: Golbat
dexText: It clamps down on its prey with needle-  sharp fangs and drains over 10 ounces of  blood in one gulp.

name: Oddish
dexText: Its scientific name is “Oddium Wanderus.”  At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000  feet on its two roots.

name: Gloom
dexText: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor.  The horrid stench can cause fainting at a  distance of 1.25 miles.

name: Vileplume
dexText: Its petals are the largest in the world.  It fiendishly scatters allergy-causing  pollen from its petals.

name: Paras
dexText: Growing out of the bug's back are  mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms  grow with the bug host.

name: Parasect
dexText: It scatters toxic spores from the  mushroom cap. In China, the spores are  used as herbal medicine.

name: Venonat
dexText: Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be  active in darkness. The eyes can also  shoot powerful beams.

name: Venomoth
dexText: The wings are covered with dustlike  scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it  looses highly toxic dust.

name: Diglett
dexText: It burrows through the ground at a  shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in  its wake, making it easy to spot.

name: Dugtrio
dexText: In battle, it digs through the ground and  strikes the unsuspecting foe from an  unexpected direction.

name: Meowth
dexText: All it does is sleep during the daytime.  At night, it patrols its territory with its  eyes aglow.

name: Persian
dexText: Has a vicious temperament. Beware if it  raises its tail straight up. It is a signal  that it is about to pounce and bite.

name: Psyduck
dexText: It is constantly wracked by a headache.  When the headache turns intense, it begins  using mysterious powers.

name: Golduck
dexText: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make  it an adept swimmer. It can be seen  swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

name: Mankey
dexText: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious  in temperament. When angered, it flies into  an uncontrollable frenzy.

name: Primeape
dexText: It is always outrageously furious. If it  gives chase, it will tenaciously track the  target no matter how far.

name: Growlithe

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.text: Powers up if hit by fire.

dexText: Very friendly and faithful to people.  It will try to repel enemies by barking  and biting.

name: Arcanine

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.text: Powers up if hit by fire.

dexText: A POKéMON that is described in Chinese  legends. It is said to race at an  unbelievable speed.

name: Poliwag
dexText: Its slick black skin is thin and damp.  A part of its internal organs can be seen  through the skin as a spiral pattern.

name: Poliwhirl
dexText: Its two legs are well developed.  Even though it can live on the ground,  it prefers living in water.

evolutions.note: Trade while holding the item: needs a link cable and a second game.

name: Poliwrath
dexText: An adept swimmer, it knows the front  crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster  than the best human swimmers.

name: Abra
dexText: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a  variety of extrasensory powers even  while asleep.

name: Kadabra
dexText: It happened one morning - a boy with  extrasensory powers awoke in bed  transformed into KADABRA.

evolutions.note: Trade-only: needs a link cable and a second game.

name: Alakazam
dexText: It does not like physical attacks very   much. Instead, it freely uses extra-  sensory powers to defeat foes.

name: Machop
dexText: Its whole body is composed of muscles.  Even though it's the size of a human  child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
dexText: Its formidable body never gets tired.  It helps people by doing work such as  the moving of heavy goods.

evolutions.note: Trade-only: needs a link cable and a second game.

name: Machamp
dexText: Its four ruggedly developed arms can  launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just  two seconds.

name: Bellsprout
dexText: Its bud looks like a human face. Because  of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of  legendary mandrake plant.

name: Weepinbell
dexText: The leafy parts act as cutters for  slashing foes. It spits a fluid that  dissolves everything.

name: Victreebel
dexText: Lures prey into its mouth with a honeylike  aroma. The helpless prey is melted with  a dissolving fluid.

name: Tentacool
dexText: Its eyes are as transparent as crystals.  From them, it shoots mysterious  beams of light.

name: Tentacruel
dexText: It has 80 tentacles that move about  freely. They can sting, causing poisoning  and sharp, stabbing pain.

name: Geodude
dexText: Its round form makes it easy to pick up.  Some people have used them to hurl  at each other in a snowball fight.

name: Graveler
dexText: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails.  GRAVELER may come rolling down the path  without slowing.

evolutions.note: Trade-only: needs a link cable and a second game.

name: Golem
dexText: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as  rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin  once a year to grow larger.

name: Ponyta

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.text: Powers up if hit by fire.

dexText: Its body is light, and its legs are  incredibly powerful. It can clear  Ayers Rock in one leap.

name: Rapidash

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.text: Powers up if hit by fire.

dexText: It can gallop at a top speed of 150  miles per hour. It can race as fast as a  bullet train while ablaze.

name: Slowpoke
dexText: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but  no one knows what it is thinking about.  It is good at fishing with its tail.

evolutions.note: Trade while holding the item: needs a link cable and a second game.

name: Slowbro
dexText: When a SLOWPOKE went hunting in the sea,  its tail was bitten by a SHELLDER. That  made it evolve into SLOWBRO.

name: Magnemite
dexText: It moves while constantly hovering.  It discharges THUNDER WAVE and so on  from the units at its sides.

name: Magneton
dexText: A linked cluster formed of several  MAGNEMITE. It discharges powerful  magnetic waves at high voltage.

name: Farfetch’d
dexText: It always walks about with a plant stalk  clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for  building its nest.

name: Doduo
dexText: A two-headed POKéMON that was discovered  as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace  of over 60 miles per hour.

name: Dodrio
dexText: An odd species that is rarely found.  The three heads respectively represent  joy, sadness, and anger.

name: Seel
dexText: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is  thick and tough. It is active in bitter  cold of minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Dewgong
dexText: Its body is covered with a pure white  fur. The colder the weather, the more  active it becomes.

name: Grimer
dexText: Sludge exposed to X rays from the moon  transformed into GRIMER. It loves feeding  on filthy things.

name: Muk
dexText: It is usually undetectable because it  blends in with the ground. Touching it can  cause terrible poisoning.

name: Shellder
dexText: It is encased in a shell that is harder  than diamond. Inside, however, it is  surprisingly tender.

name: Cloyster
dexText: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be  shattered, even with a bomb. The shell  opens only when it is attacking.

name: Gastly
dexText: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can  topple an Indian elephant by enveloping  the prey in two seconds.

name: Haunter
dexText: If you get the feeling of being watched  in darkness when nobody is around,  HAUNTER is there.

evolutions.note: Trade-only: needs a link cable and a second game.

name: Gengar
dexText: It is said to emerge from darkness to  steal the lives of those who become lost  in mountains.

name: Onix
dexText: It usually lives underground. It searches  for food while boring its way through the  ground at 50 miles per hour.

evolutions.note: Trade while holding the item: needs a link cable and a second game.

name: Drowzee
dexText: A descendent of the legendary animal  baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is  skilled at hypnotism.

name: Hypno
dexText: It carries a pendulum-like device. There  once was an incident in which it took   away a child it hypnotized.

name: Krabby
dexText: It can be found near the sea. The large  pincers grow back if they are torn out of  their sockets.

name: Kingler
dexText: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-  horsepower strength. However, being so  big, it is unwieldy to move.

name: Voltorb
dexText: A life-form whose identity is unknown.  It is said to SCREECH or suddenly  SELFDESTRUCT.

name: Electrode
dexText: It explodes in response to even minor  stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname  of “The Bomb Ball.”

name: Exeggcute
dexText: Even though it appears to be eggs of  some sort, it was discovered to be a life-  form more like plant seeds.

name: Exeggutor
dexText: It is called “The Walking Tropical  Rainforest.” Each of the nuts has  a face and a will of its own.

name: Cubone
dexText: It wears the skull of its dead mother on  its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is  said to cry loudly.

name: Marowak
dexText: It is small and was originally very weak.  Its temperament turned ferocious when it  began using bones.

name: Hitmonlee
dexText: The legs freely contract and stretch.  The stretchy legs allow it to hit a  distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Hitmonchan
dexText: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this  POKéMON. It throws punches that are  faster than a bullet train.

name: Lickitung
dexText: Its tongue is twice the length of its  body. It can be moved like an arm for  grabbing food and attacking.

name: Koffing
dexText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by  horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is  nearby.

name: Weezing
dexText: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result  in two small KOFFING twins becoming  conjoined as a WEEZING.

name: Rhyhorn
dexText: Strong, but not too bright, this POKéMON  can shatter even a skyscraper with its  charging TACKLES.

name: Rhydon
dexText: It begins walking on its hind legs after  evolution. It can punch holes through  boulders with its horn.

name: Chansey
dexText: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are  apparently rich in nutrients and extremely  delicious.

name: Tangela
dexText: Blue plant vines cloak the POKéMON's  identity in a tangled mass. It entangles  anything that gets close.

name: Kangaskhan
dexText: The female raises its offspring in a pouch  on its belly. It is skilled at attacking  using COMET PUNCH.

name: Horsea
dexText: It maintains balance using its tail, which  is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink  from its mouth.

name: Seadra
dexText: Its body bristles with sharp spikes.  Carelessly trying to touch it could cause  fainting from the spikes.

evolutions.note: Trade while holding the item: needs a link cable and a second game.

name: Goldeen
dexText: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly  developed like muscles. It can swim at a  speed of five knots.

name: Seaking
dexText: The horn on its head is sharp like a  drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to  make its nest.

name: Staryu
dexText: It appears in large numbers by seashores.  At night, its central core flashes with a  red light.

name: Starmie
dexText: This POKéMON has a geometric body.  Because of its body, the locals suspect  that it is an alien creature.

name: Mr. Mime
dexText: It is adept at conning people. It is said  to be able to create walls out of thin  air by miming.

name: Scyther

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.text: Ups BUG moves in a pinch.

dexText: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly  sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its  wings to fly.

evolutions.note: Trade while holding the item: needs a link cable and a second game.

name: Jynx
dexText: It speaks using a language that sounds  human. Research is under way to determine  what is being said.

name: Electabuzz
dexText: It loves to feed on strong electricity.  It occasionally appears around large  power plants and so on.

name: Magmar
dexText: Found near the mouth of a volcano.  This fire-breather's body temperature is  nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Pinsir
dexText: Its two long pincer horns are powerful.  Once they grip an enemy, they won't  release until the foe is torn.

name: Tauros
dexText: When it is about to TACKLE, it whips  its body repeatedly with its three  long tails.

name: Magikarp
dexText: It is virtually worthless in terms of both  power and speed. It is the most weak and  pathetic POKéMON in the world.

name: Gyarados
dexText: It has an extremely aggressive nature.  The HYPER BEAM it shoots from its mouth  totally incinerates all targets.

name: Lapras
dexText: Its high intelligence enables it to  understand human speech. It likes to ferry  people on its back.

name: Ditto
dexText: It can freely recombine its own cellular  structure to transform into other life-  forms.

name: Eevee
dexText: An extremely rare POKéMON that may  evolve in a number of different ways  depending on stimuli.

evolutions.note: FireRed has no clock, so this evolution only works after trading to Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald.
FireRed has no clock, so this evolution only works after trading to Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald.

name: Vaporeon
dexText: Its body's cellular structure is similar to  the molecular composition of water.  It can melt invisibly in water.

name: Jolteon
dexText: If it is angered or startled, the fur all  over its body bristles like sharp needles  that pierce foes.

name: Flareon

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.text: Powers up if hit by fire.

dexText: It has a flame bag inside its body. After  inhaling deeply, it blows out flames of  nearly 3,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Porygon
dexText: Using the most advanced technologies,  scientists finally succeeded in making the  first artificial POKéMON.

evolutions.note: Trade while holding the item: needs a link cable and a second game.

name: Omanyte
dexText: A prehistoric POKéMON that lived in the  primordial sea, it swims by twisting its  10 tentacles about.

name: Omastar
dexText: Its tentacles are highly developed as if  they are hands and feet. As soon as it  ensnares prey, it bites.

name: Kabuto
dexText: This POKéMON was regenerated from the  fossil of an ancient creature. It protects  itself with a hard shell.

name: Kabutops
dexText: It swims freely through water. It catches  prey with its scythe-like arms and drains  the victim's fluids.

name: Aerodactyl
dexText: It was regenerated from a dinosaur's  genetic matter that was found in amber.  It flies with high-pitched cries.

name: Snorlax
dexText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880  pounds of food every day. When it is done  eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Articuno
dexText: One of the legendary bird POKéMON.  With its long tail trailing behind, its  flying form is magnificent.

name: Zapdos
dexText: One of the legendary bird POKéMON.  While it is flying, it makes crackling and  snapping sounds.

name: Moltres
dexText: One of the legendary bird POKéMON.  Those seeing it are overwhelmed by its  orange wings that seem to be on fire.

name: Dratini
dexText: Even the young can exceed 6.5 feet in  length. It grows larger by repeatedly  shedding skin.

name: Dragonair
dexText: It is said to live in seas and lakes.  Even though it has no wings, it has been  seen flying occasionally.

name: Dragonite
dexText: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky  physique. It circles the globe in just  16 hours.

name: Mewtwo
dexText: A POKéMON whose genetic code was  repeatedly recombined for research.  It turned vicious as a result.

name: Mew
dexText: A POKéMON of South America that was  thought to have been extinct. It is very  intelligent and learns any move.

name: Chikorita

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.text: Ups GRASS moves in a pinch.

dexText: Its pleasantly aromatic leaves have the  Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the  ability to check the humidity and  temperature.

name: Bayleef

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.text: Ups GRASS moves in a pinch.

dexText: A spicy aroma emanates from around its  neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to  restore health.

name: Meganium

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.text: Ups GRASS moves in a pinch.

dexText: MEGANIUM's breath has the power to revive  dead grass and plants. It can make them  healthy again.

name: Cyndaquil

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.text: Ups FIRE moves in a pinch.

dexText: It usually stays hunched over. If it is  angry or surprised, it shoots flames out  of its back.

name: Quilava

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.text: Ups FIRE moves in a pinch.

dexText: This POKéMON is fully covered by  nonflammable fur. It can withstand any  kind of fire attack.

name: Typhlosion

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.text: Ups FIRE moves in a pinch.

dexText: It has a secret, devastating move. It  rubs its blazing fur together to cause  huge explosions.

name: Totodile

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.text: Ups WATER moves in a pinch.

dexText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't  hesitate to take a bite out of anything  that moves.

name: Croconaw

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.text: Ups WATER moves in a pinch.

dexText: It opens its huge jaws wide when  attacking. If it loses any fangs while  biting, they grow back in.

name: Feraligatr

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.text: Ups WATER moves in a pinch.

dexText: It is hard for it to support its own  weight out of water, so it gets down on  all fours. But it moves fast.

name: Sentret
dexText: It stands on its tail so it can see a long  way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly  to warn its kind.

name: Furret
dexText: There is no telling where its tail begins.  Despite its short legs, it is quick at  hunting RATTATA.

name: Hoothoot
dexText: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever  happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely  tilting its head in time.

name: Noctowl
dexText: When it needs to think, it rotates its head  180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual  power.

name: Ledyba

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.text: Ups BUG moves in a pinch.

dexText: When the weather turns cold, numerous  LEDYBA gather from everywhere to cluster  and keep each other warm.

name: Ledian

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.text: Ups BUG moves in a pinch.

dexText: The star patterns on its back grow larger  or smaller depending on the number of  stars in the night sky.

name: Spinarak

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.text: Ups BUG moves in a pinch.

dexText: It spins a web using fine--but durable--  thread. It then waits patiently for prey  to be trapped.

name: Ariados

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.text: Ups BUG moves in a pinch.

dexText: A single strand of a special string is  endlessly spun out of its rear. The string  leads back to its nest.

name: Crobat
dexText: The development of wings on its legs  enables it to fly fast but also makes it  tough to stop and rest.

name: Chinchou
dexText: On the dark ocean floor, its only means  of communication is its constantly  flashing lights.

name: Lanturn
dexText: It blinds prey with an intense burst of  light, then swallows the immobilized prey  in a single gulp.

name: Pichu
dexText: Despite its small size, it can zap even  adult humans. However, if it does so, it  also surprises itself.

name: Cleffa
dexText: When numerous meteors illuminate the  night sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely  increase.

name: Igglybuff
dexText: Its extremely flexible and elastic body  makes it bounce continuously--anytime,  anywhere.

name: Togepi
dexText: A proverb claims that happiness will come  to anyone who can make a sleeping TOGEPI  stand up.

name: Togetic
dexText: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind  people. It can float in midair without  moving its wings.

name: Natu
dexText: It usually forages for food on the ground  but may, on rare occasions, hop onto  branches to peck at shoots.

name: Xatu
dexText: In South America, it is said that its right  eye sees the future and its left eye  views the past.

name: Mareep
dexText: Its fleece grows continually. In the  summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it  grows back in a week.

name: Flaaffy
dexText: Its fluffy fleece easily stores  electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it  from being electrocuted.

name: Ampharos
dexText: The bright light on its tail can be seen  far away. It has been treasured since  ancient times as a beacon.

name: Bellossom
dexText: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances,  its petals rub together and make a  pleasant ringing sound.

name: Marill
dexText: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that  keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious  current.

name: Azumarill
dexText: When it plays in water, it rolls up its  elongated ears to prevent their insides  from getting wet.

name: Sudowoodo
dexText: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid  attack. It hates water, so it will  disappear if it starts raining.

name: Politoed
dexText: Whenever three or more of these get  together, they sing in a loud voice that  sounds like bellowing.

name: Hoppip
dexText: Its body is so light, it must grip the  ground firmly with its feet to keep from  being blown away.

name: Skiploom
dexText: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight.  It also floats in the air to get closer to  the sun.

name: Jumpluff
dexText: It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads  its cotton-like spores all over the world   to make more offspring.

name: Aipom
dexText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping  from branch to branch, it deftly uses its  tail for balance.

name: Sunkern
dexText: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from  under the leaves of plants. It is said  that it eats nothing else.

name: Sunflora
dexText: In the daytime, it rushes about in a  hectic manner, but it comes to a complete  stop when the sun sets.

name: Yanma
dexText: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees.  It looks in all directions to seek out  insects as its prey.

name: Wooper
dexText: When it walks around on the ground,  it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous  film.

name: Quagsire
dexText: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude,  it often bumps its head on boulders and  boat hulls as it swims.

name: Espeon
dexText: By reading air currents, it can predict  things such as the weather or its foe's  next move.

name: Umbreon
dexText: When darkness falls, the rings on its body  begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts  of anyone nearby.

name: Murkrow
dexText: It is said that when chased, it lures its  attacker onto dark mountain trails where  the foe will get lost.

name: Slowking
dexText: When its head was bitten, toxins entered  SLOWPOKE's head and unlocked an  extraordinary power.

name: Misdreavus
dexText: It loves to bite and yank people's hair  from behind without warning, just to see  their shocked reactions.

name: Unown
dexText: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on  walls. Its shape appears to have some  meaning.

name: Wobbuffet
dexText: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it  lives quietly in the darkness. It is never  first to attack.

name: Girafarig
dexText: Its tail, which also contains a small  brain, may bite on its own if it notices an  alluring smell.

name: Pineco
dexText: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey  to come near. It does not move about  much on its own.

name: Forretress
dexText: It remains immovably rooted to its tree.  It scatters pieces of its hard shell to  drive its enemies away.

name: Dunsparce
dexText: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with  its tail. It can hover just slightly using  its wings.

name: Gligar
dexText: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots  its prey, it spreads its wings and glides  down to attack.

name: Steelix
dexText: It is said that if an ONIX lives for over  100 years, its composition changes to  become diamond-like.

name: Snubbull
dexText: It has an active, playful nature. Many  women like to frolic with it because of  its affectionate ways.

name: Granbull
dexText: Because its fangs are too heavy, it  always keeps its head tilted down.  However, its BITE is powerful.

name: Qwilfish
dexText: The small spikes covering its body  developed from scales. They inject a  toxin that causes fainting.

name: Scizor

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.text: Ups BUG moves in a pinch.

dexText: Its wings are not used for flying.  They are flapped at high speed to adjust  its body temperature.

name: Shuckle
dexText: It stores BERRIES inside its shell.  To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks  and remains completely still.

name: Heracross

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.text: Ups BUG moves in a pinch.

dexText: Usually docile, but if disturbed while  sipping honey, it chases off the intruder  with its horn.

name: Sneasel
dexText: Vicious in nature, it drives PIDGEY from  their nests and feasts on the eggs that  are left behind.

name: Teddiursa
dexText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime,  its habit is to hoard food in many hidden  locations.

name: Ursaring
dexText: With its ability to distinguish any smell,  it unfailingly finds all food buried deep  underground.

name: Slugma
dexText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it  slowly slithers around in a constant  search for warm places.

name: Magcargo
dexText: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts  intense flames that circulate throughout  its body.

name: Swinub
dexText: If it smells something enticing, it dashes  off headlong to find the source of the  aroma.

name: Piloswine
dexText: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on  its back stand up straight. It is very  sensitive to sound.

name: Corsola
dexText: In a south sea nation, the people live in  communities that are built on groups of  these POKéMON.

name: Remoraid
dexText: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it  clings to a MANTINE's underside to  scavenge for leftovers.

name: Octillery
dexText: It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes.  If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a  fellow OCTILLERY.

name: Delibird
dexText: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs.  It spends all day carrying food to its  awaiting chicks.

name: Mantine
dexText: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly  out of the water and over the waves if it  builds up enough speed.

name: Skarmory
dexText: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings  of its chicks grow hard from scratches by  thorns.

name: Houndour

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.text: Powers up if hit by fire.

dexText: To corner prey, they check each other's  location using barks that only they can  understand.

name: Houndoom

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.text: Powers up if hit by fire.

dexText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other  POKéMON get the shivers and head straight  back to their nests.

name: Kingdra
dexText: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to  build its energy. It is said to cause  tornadoes as it wakes.

name: Phanpy
dexText: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its  snout. However, it is so strong, it may  send you flying.

name: Donphan
dexText: The longer and bigger its tusks, the  higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take  a long time to grow.

name: Porygon2
dexText: Further research enhanced its abilities.  Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that  were not programmed.

name: Stantler
dexText: Those who stare at its antlers will  gradually lose control of their senses  and be unable to stand.

name: Smeargle
dexText: Once it becomes an adult, it has a  tendency to let its comrades plant  footprints on its back.

name: Tyrogue
dexText: Even though it is small, it can't be  ignored because it will slug any handy  target without warning.

evolutions.note: Attack lower than Defense
Attack higher than Defense
Attack equal to Defense

name: Hitmontop
dexText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it  spins at high speed, it may bore its way  into the ground.

name: Smoochum
dexText: It always rocks its head slowly backwards  and forwards as if it is trying to kiss  someone.

name: Elekid
dexText: Even in the most vicious storm, this  POKéMON plays happily if thunder rumbles  in the sky.

name: Magby
dexText: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body  heat exceeds 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit,  so don't underestimate it.

name: Miltank
dexText: If it has just had a baby, the milk it  produces contains much more nutrition than  usual.

name: Blissey
dexText: It has a very compassionate nature. If it  sees a sick POKéMON, it will nurse the  sufferer back to health.

name: Raikou
dexText: This POKéMON races across the  land while barking a cry that sounds  like crashing thunder.

name: Entei
dexText: A POKéMON that races across the land.  It is said that one is born every time a  new volcano appears.

name: Suicune
dexText: This POKéMON races across the land.  It is said that north winds will somehow  blow whenever it appears.

name: Larvitar
dexText: It is born deep underground. It can't  emerge until it has entirely consumed the  soil around it.

name: Pupitar
dexText: Even sealed in its shell, it can move  freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding  destructive power.

name: Tyranitar
dexText: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of  attack, so it is very eager to make  challenges against enemies. It has an impudent nature. Having great  strength, it can even change surrounding  landforms.

name: Lugia
dexText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas.  It is rumored to have been seen on the  night of a storm.

name: Ho-Oh
dexText: A legend says that its body glows in  seven colors. A rainbow is said to form  behind it when it flies.

name: Celebi
dexText: When CELEBI disappears deep in a forest,  it is said to leave behind an egg it  brought from the future.

name: Treecko

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.text: Ups GRASS moves in a pinch.

dexText: It quickly scales even vertical walls.  It senses humidity with its tail to predict  the next day's weather.

name: Grovyle

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.text: Ups GRASS moves in a pinch.

dexText: Its strongly developed thigh muscles  give it astounding agility and jumping  performance.

name: Sceptile

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.text: Ups GRASS moves in a pinch.

dexText: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp  as swords. It agilely leaps about the  branches of trees to strike.

name: Torchic

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.text: Ups FIRE moves in a pinch.

dexText: It has a flame sac inside its belly that  perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is  hugged.

name: Combusken

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.text: Ups FIRE moves in a pinch.

dexText: It boosts its concentration by emitting  harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding  destructive power.

name: Blaziken

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.text: Ups FIRE moves in a pinch.

dexText: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames  from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it  jump clear over buildings.

name: Mudkip

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.text: Ups WATER moves in a pinch.

dexText: Its large tail fin propels it through  water with powerful acceleration. It is  strong in spite of its size.

name: Marshtomp

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.text: Ups WATER moves in a pinch.

dexText: It is at its best when on muddy ground  with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms  foes struggling in mud.

name: Swampert

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.text: Ups WATER moves in a pinch.

dexText: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing,  they can batter down its foe. It makes its  nest on beautiful beaches.

name: Poochyena
dexText: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute  sense of smell lets it chase a chosen  prey without ever losing track.

name: Mightyena
dexText: It will always obey the commands of a  skilled TRAINER. Its behavior arises from  its living in packs in ancient times.

name: Zigzagoon
dexText: A POKéMON with abundant curiosity.  It shows an interest in everything, so it  always zigs and zags.

name: Linoone
dexText: When running in a straight line, it can top  60 miles per hour. However, it has a  tough time with curved roads.

name: Wurmple
dexText: It lives amidst tall grass and in forests.  When attacked, it resists by pointing its  venomous spikes at the foe.

evolutions.note: 50% chance (personality)
50% chance (personality)

name: Silcoon
dexText: It conserves its energy by moving as  little as possible. It awaits evolution  while drinking only a little rainwater.

name: Beautifly

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.text: Ups BUG moves in a pinch.

dexText: Despite its appearance, it has an  aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing  with its long, thin mouth.

name: Cascoon
dexText: Its body, which is made of soft silk,  hardens over time. When cracks appear,  evolution is near.

name: Dustox
dexText: It scatters horribly toxic dust when it  senses danger. They tend to gather in the  glow of streetlamps at night.

name: Lotad
dexText: It searches about for clean water. If it  does not drink water for too long, the  leaf on its head wilts.

name: Lombre
dexText: It lives at the water's edge where it is  sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass  by day and becomes active at night.

name: Ludicolo
dexText: The rhythm of bright, festive music  activates LUDICOLO's cells, making it more  powerful.

name: Seedot
dexText: If it remains still, it becomes impossible  to distinguish from real nuts. It delights  in surprising foraging PIDGEY.

name: Nuzleaf
dexText: They live in holes bored in large trees.  The sound of NUZLEAF's grass flute fills  listeners with dread.

name: Shiftry
dexText: A POKéMON that was feared as a forest  guardian. It can read the foe's mind and  take preemptive action.

name: Taillow
dexText: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to  other lands in search of warmth, flying  over 180 miles a day.

name: Swellow
dexText: If its two tail feathers are standing at  attention, it is proof of good health.  It soars elegantly in the sky.

name: Wingull
dexText: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were  a glider. In the winter, it hides food  around its nest.

name: Pelipper
dexText: It is a flying transporter that carries  small POKéMON in its beak. It bobs on the  waves to rest its wings.

name: Ralts
dexText: It is highly attuned to the emotions of  people and POKéMON. It hides if it senses  hostility.

name: Kirlia
dexText: The cheerful spirit of its TRAINER gives  it energy for its psychokinetic power.  It spins and dances when happy.

name: Gardevoir
dexText: It has the power to predict the future.  Its power peaks when it is protecting its  TRAINER.

name: Surskit
dexText: They usually live on ponds, but after an  evening shower, they may appear on  puddles in towns.

name: Masquerain
dexText: The antennae have distinctive patterns  that look like eyes. When it rains, they  grow heavy, making flight impossible.

name: Shroomish
dexText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains  still in the forest shade. It releases  toxic powder from its head.

name: Breloom
dexText: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic  spores. It knocks out foes with quick,  virtually invisible punches.

name: Slakoth
dexText: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making  drowsy those that see it is one of  its abilities.

name: Vigoroth
dexText: It is always hungry because it won't stop  rampaging. Even while it is eating, it  can't keep still.

name: Slaking
dexText: It is the world's most slothful POKéMON.  However, it can exert horrifying power by  releasing pent-up energy all at once.

name: Nincada
dexText: Because it lived almost entirely  underground, it is nearly blind.  It uses its antennae instead.

evolutions.note: Appears too if you have a free party slot and a Poké Ball

name: Ninjask
dexText: This POKéMON is so quick, it is said to  be able to avoid any attack. It loves to  feed on tree sap.

name: Shedinja
dexText: A most peculiar POKéMON that somehow  appears in a POKé BALL when a NINCADA  evolves.

name: Whismur
dexText: It usually murmurs, but starts crying  loudly if it senses danger. It stops when  its ear covers are shut.

name: Loudred
dexText: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it  generates ultrasonic waves that can blow  apart a house.

name: Exploud
dexText: It emits a variety of sounds from the   holes all over its body. Its loud cries  can be heard from over six miles away.

name: Makuhita
dexText: It grows stronger by enduring harsh  training. It is a gutsy POKéMON that can  withstand any attack.

name: Hariyama
dexText: It stomps on the ground to build power.  It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a  straight-arm punch.

name: Azurill
dexText: It battles by flinging around its tail,  which is bigger than its body. The  tail is a flotation device in water.

name: Nosepass
dexText: Its magnetic nose consistently faces  north. Travelers check NOSEPASS to get  their bearings.

name: Skitty
dexText: It is said to be difficult to earn its  trust. However, it is extremely popular  for its cute looks and behavior.

name: Delcatty
dexText: The favorite of trend-conscious  female TRAINERS, they are used in  competition for their style and fur.

name: Sableye
dexText: It feeds on gemstone crystals.  In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the  glitter of jewels.

name: Mawile
dexText: It uses its docile-looking face to lull  foes into complacency, then bites with its  huge, relentless jaws.

name: Aron
dexText: It eats iron to build its steel body.  It is a pest that descends from mountains  to eat bridges and train tracks.

name: Lairon
dexText: It habitually shows off its strength with  the size of sparks it creates by ramming  its steel body into boulders.

name: Aggron
dexText: It claims a large mountain as its sole  territory. It mercilessly thrashes those  that violate its space.

name: Meditite
dexText: It never skips its daily yoga training.  It heightens its inner strength through  meditation.

name: Medicham
dexText: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-  like steps, then launches a devastating  blow in the same motion.

name: Electrike
dexText: It stores static electricity in its fur  for discharging. It gives off sparks if a  storm approaches.

name: Manectric
dexText: It rarely appears before people.  It is said to nest where lightning has  fallen.

name: Plusle
dexText: It cheers on partners while scattering  sparks from its body. It climbs telephone  poles to absorb electricity.

name: Minun
dexText: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter  under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses  pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.

name: Volbeat

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.text: Ups BUG moves in a pinch.

dexText: It lives around clean ponds. At night,  its rear lights up. It converses with  others by flashing its light.

name: Illumise
dexText: It guides VOLBEAT to draw signs in night  skies. There are scientists that study the  patterns it creates.

name: Roselia
dexText: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance.  The stronger its aroma, the healthier  the ROSELIA is.

name: Gulpin
dexText: There is nothing its stomach can't digest.  While it is digesting, vile, overpowering  gases are expelled.

name: Swalot
dexText: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp.  It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from  the pores on its body.

name: Carvanha
dexText: It lives in massive rivers that course  through jungles. It swarms prey that  enter its territory.

name: Sharpedo
dexText: The ruffian of the seas, it has fangs that  crunch through iron. It swims by jetting  water from its rear.

name: Wailmer
dexText: When it sucks in a large volume of  seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy  ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

name: Wailord
dexText: It is among the largest of all POKéMON.  It herds prey in a pack then swallows the  massed prey in one gulp.

name: Numel
dexText: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit  courses through its body. When it grows  cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

name: Camerupt
dexText: If angered, the humps on its back erupt  in a shower of molten lava. It lives in  the craters of volcanoes.

name: Torkoal
dexText: It burns coal inside its shell. If it is  attacked, it belches thick, black smoke  and flees.

name: Spoink
dexText: It apparently dies if it stops bouncing  about. It carries a pearl from CLAMPERL  on its head.

name: Grumpig
dexText: It can gain control over foes by doing  odd dance steps. The black pearls on its  forehead are precious gems.

name: Spinda
dexText: No two SPINDA are said to have identical  patterns. It confuses foes with its  stumbling motions.

name: Trapinch
dexText: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a  sloping pit trap in sand where it  patiently awaits prey.

name: Vibrava
dexText: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently  flapping its wings. After making its prey  faint, it melts the prey with acid.

name: Flygon
dexText: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand  with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes  from sand.

name: Cacnea
dexText: It prefers harsh environments such as  deserts. It can survive for 30 days on  water stored in its body.

name: Cacturne
dexText: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at  night when it hunts for prey exhausted  from the desert's heat.

name: Swablu
dexText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like  wings. It takes a shower to clean  itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Altaria
dexText: If you hear a beautiful melody trilling  deep among mountains far from people,  it is ALTARIA's humming.

name: Zangoose
dexText: If it comes across a SEVIPER, its fur  bristles and it assumes its battle pose.  Its sharp claws are its best weapon.

name: Seviper
dexText: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard  rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes  unwary prey with venomous fangs.

name: Lunatone
dexText: Its health ebbs and flows with the lunar  cycle. It brims with power when exposed  to the light of the full moon.

name: Solrock
dexText: It absorbs solar energy during the day.  Always expressionless, it can sense what  its foe is thinking.

name: Barboach
dexText: It probes muddy riverbeds with its two  long whiskers. A slimy film protects its  body.

name: Whiscash
dexText: It makes its nest at the bottom of   swamps. It will eat anything - if it is  alive, WHISCASH will eat it.

name: Corphish
dexText: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy  creature that will quickly proliferate,  even in polluted streams.

name: Crawdaunt
dexText: A rough customer that wildly flails its  giant claws. It is said to be extremely  hard to raise.

name: Baltoy
dexText: It was discovered in ancient ruins.  While moving, it constantly spins. It  stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Claydol
dexText: It appears to have been born from clay  dolls made by ancient people. It uses  telekinesis to float and move.

name: Lileep
dexText: It became extinct roughly 100 million  years ago. It was regenerated from a  fossil using advanced techniques.

name: Cradily
dexText: It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles.  It then melts the prey with a strong acid  before feeding.

name: Anorith
dexText: It is a kind of POKéMON progenitor.  It uses its extending claws to catch prey  hiding among rocks on the seafloor.

name: Armaldo
dexText: Protected by a hard shell, its body is  very sturdy. It skewers prey with its  claws to feed.

name: Feebas
dexText: Ridiculed for its shabby appearance,  it is ignored by researchers. It lives in  ponds choked with weeds.

evolutions.note: Needs max Beauty from Pokéblocks: impossible in FireRed.

name: Milotic
dexText: MILOTIC is breathtakingly beautiful.  Those that see it are said to forget their  combative spirits.

name: Castform
dexText: It has the ability to change its form into  the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud,   depending on the weather.

name: Kecleon
dexText: It changes body color to blend in with  its surroundings. It also changes color if  it is happy or sad.

name: Shuppet
dexText: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and  malice. Its upright horn catches the  emotions of people.

name: Banette
dexText: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet  into a POKéMON. If it opens its mouth,  its cursed energy escapes.

name: Duskull
dexText: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks  up to prey. It has the ability to slip  through thick walls.

name: Dusclops
dexText: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens  its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it  were a black hole.

name: Tropius
dexText: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of  fruit around its neck is delicious.  The fruit grows twice a year.

name: Chimecho
dexText: It travels by riding on winds. It cleverly  uses its long tail to pluck nuts and  berries, which it loves to eat.

name: Absol
dexText: It appears when it senses an impending  natural disaster. As a result, it was  mistaken as a doom-bringer.

name: Wynaut
dexText: It tends to move in a pack with others.  They cluster in a tight group to sleep in  a cave.

name: Snorunt
dexText: It is said that a home visited by a  SNORUNT will prosper. It can withstand  cold of minus 150 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Glalie
dexText: It has a body of ice that won't melt,  even with fire. It can instantly freeze  moisture in the atmosphere.

name: Spheal
dexText: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The  fur keeps it from feeling cold while  it is rolling on ice.

name: Sealeo
dexText: It touches new things with its nose to  test for smell and feel. It plays by  spinning SPHEAL on its nose.

name: Walrein
dexText: It swims through icy seas while shattering  ice floes with its large tusks. It is  protected by its thick blubber.

name: Clamperl
dexText: It is protected by a sturdy shell.  Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent  pearl.

evolutions.note: Trade while holding the item: needs a link cable and a second game.
Trade while holding the item: needs a link cable and a second game.

name: Huntail
dexText: It lives deep in the sea where no light  ever filters down. It lights up its small  fishlike tail to attract prey.

name: Gorebyss
dexText: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant.  With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed  that grows between rocks.

name: Relicanth
dexText: It has remained unchanged for 100  million years. It was discovered  during a deep-sea exploration.

name: Luvdisc
dexText: During the spawning season, countless  LUVDISC congregate at coral reefs,  turning the waters pink.

name: Bagon
dexText: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders.  It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it  can fly.

name: Shelgon
dexText: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce  off. The armor is too tough, however,  making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.

name: Salamence
dexText: It becomes uncontrollable if it is  enraged. It destroys everything with  shredding claws and fire.

name: Beldum
dexText: It uses magnetic waves to converse with  its kind. All the cells in its body are  magnetic.

name: Metang
dexText: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body  is so tough, even a crash with a jet  plane won't leave a scratch.

name: Metagross
dexText: It is formed by two METANG fusing.  Its four brains are said to be superior  to a supercomputer.

name: Regirock
dexText: It is entirely composed of rocks with no  sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery  even to modern scientists.

name: Regice
dexText: Research revealed that its body is made  of the same kind of ice that is found at  the South Pole.

name: Registeel
dexText: It is sturdier than any kind of metal.  It hardened due to pressure underground  over tens of thousands of years.

name: Latias
dexText: It can telepathically communicate with  people. It changes its appearance using  its down that refracts light.

name: Latios
dexText: It has a docile temperament and dislikes  fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can  fly faster than a jet plane.

name: Kyogre
dexText: This POKéMON is said to have  expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains.  It has the power to control water.

name: Groudon
dexText: This legendary POKéMON is said to  represent the land. It went to sleep after  dueling KYOGRE.

name: Rayquaza
dexText: It has lived for hundreds of millions of  years in the ozone layer. Its flying form  looks like a meteor.

name: Jirachi
dexText: It is said to make any wish come true.  It is awake for only seven days out of  a thousand years.

name: Deoxys
dexText: This DEOXYS has transformed into its  aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by  altering its appearance.
